00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000032.title: Lighthouse mechanics
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000032.synopsis: How a clockwork lamp turns, how often it is wound, and what the machinery sounds like from the kitchen below.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000032.notes: Enough to be right about the sound. No more.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000033.title: Tides and timetables
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000033.synopsis: When a ferry can and cannot cross a shallow bay; why a timetable can be accurate and useless at once.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000033.notes: Tomas’s crossings should be plausible even when the island is not.
